x: Meanwhile, Jim McGrath was doing his usual stirling work in the field finishing fifth in the pole vault with 11'-6" and sixth in the long jump with 22'-2¼"---only 5¼" short of third place!
Dave Mitchell was another to have an off day recording a mediocre 2:1.7. Jim McGrath reached the long jump final and with a leap of 22'3¾" finished sixth.

Jim McGrath, that stalwart athlete who is the backbone of our field events section, was in fine "decathlon" form, winning the long jump, high jump and discus, and finishing third in the javelin: a fine afternoon's effort.

Jim McGrath's 11'6" gave him second place in the Pole Vault, but his jumping was affected by a badly ricked ankle. Despite this, he still took part in his usual "double", and finished 6th in the long jump with 20'11".
However, that oft - repeated maxim "success breeds success" could easily be set in motion should we discover another Mal Ash or a Jim McGrath.
In the recent Australian Veterans' Championships the pole vault was won by JIM McGRATH, once our leading field events' exponent. Nice to know that he is still keeping in trim.
